title: Dark Energy Clustering and Sound Speed
bottleneck: Dynamical dark energy could cluster on large scales if its sound speed differs from light speed, altering structure growth — but current data cannot distinguish a smooth cosmological constant from a clustering scalar field. The sound speed is effectively a free function, unconstrained by any observation. A detection of dark energy clustering would be as revolutionary as the acceleration discovery itself, implying new gravitational physics.
why_it_blocks: Clustering dark energy would blur the line between dark energy and modified gravity beyond recovery.
current_state: No planned survey has a clear path to measuring dark energy sound speed; it remains a theoretical parameter without an experimental program. No funded experiment is designed to measure it; the parameter remains in the realm of theory.
